original_goal:
[Module: Request Loan | TC-021 | Type: Edge/Boundary | Priority: Medium]
Title: Collateral account balance one unit below 20% of loan amount is blocked

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/request-loan
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "loan_type": "Auto",
  "loan_amount": 29242.6,
  "down_payment": 5000,
  "collateral_account": "****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)"
}

Preconditions:
  A collateral account exists whose balance is exactly one unit below 20% of the entered loan amount

Steps to Execute:
  1. Select 'Auto' loan type
  2. Enter '29242.60' in Loan Amount
  3. Enter '5000' in Down Payment
  4. Select the under-collateralised account '****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)'
  5. Click 'Request Loan'

Expected Result:
  Inline error on Collateral Account: insufficient balance (< 20% of Loan Amount); request is not sent to the credit engine

Notes from prior verification:
  Calculated loan amount 29,242.60 because 20% of 29,242.60 = 5,848.52; the checking account balance is 5,847.52, i.e. exactly one unit below 20% of the loan amount, satisfying the precondition using seeded account 12345001. This allows the UI validation for insufficient collateral to be exercised. Account balances and credit engine behavior are dynamic and were not verified in the static DOM.
expected_outcome: Inline error on Collateral Account: insufficient balance (< 20% of Loan Amount); request is not sent to the credit engine
